title: Markov type characterizes superreflexivity

result.label: Markov type characterizes superreflexivity
result.statement: Proves that every real Banach space with Markov type p for some p > 1 admits an equivalent uniformly convex norm, answering Naor's renorming question. Together with the known converse, this characterizes superreflexivity by nontrivial Markov type.
